regions.today: Mainly dry with some sunshine to begin today, Thursday, but cloud will soon build this morning, with rain and drizzle spreading from the west and becoming widespread this afternoon. The rain and drizzle will continue through the rest of the day. It’ll feel rather cool with afternoon highs of 9 to 12 degrees but it’ll turn milder from the west this evening. Becoming breezy too with southwesterly winds increasing moderate to fresh with the arrival of the rain.
regions.tonight: Mostly cloudy, breezy and mild tonight, with patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle turning more persistent from the northwest overnight and towards morning. Overnight lows of 12 to 15 degrees. Moderate to fresh southwesterly winds, will become westerly overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Dull and damp or wet to begin tomorrow, Friday, with rain gradually clearing southeastwards through the morning followed by brighter, fresher conditions with sunny spells and scattered showers. Breezy with afternoon highs of 11 to 14 degrees in moderate to fresh and gusty westerly winds.
